lines:
BUILT FOR FORTY. SEALED
AGAINST A 100-MILE WIND.

A YEAR OF STORES.
10,000 GALLONS OF FUEL.

LIGHTS OFF. NOTHING FINDS
YOU FROM THE AIR.

PRIYA PICKS UP YOUR RADIO.
AND TURNS IT OVER.

IT'S A TWO-WAY SET.
EVERY TIME YOU CRANKED IT—

FOR TEN DAYS, YOU TOLD IT
EXACTLY WHERE YOU ARE.

THE LIGHTS COME BACK ON.
BY THEMSELVES.
